## Bug fixes

- Explicit governance updates can proceed when an earlier recovery left historical discovery metadata, after verifying the current installed runtime and owning chat.
- Retrying an interrupted update checks that its saved lock bytes still match before handing off the reader.
- Installation guidance now distinguishes retained-plan replay from a new request that changes managed host guidance.

## Qualification

Qualified through the normal local 4.x process, with focused regression and packaged update proof, independent review and unchanged release evidence reused where applicable. Automatic-update freshness and existing worktree pins remain unchanged. Controlled fixtures are not ordinary development or device acceptance.
